caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a classical-style figure, likely a woman, depicted from the upper chest to the top of the head. The figure has wavy, curly hair styled upward and back, and the facial features are symmetrical with prominent eyes, a straight nose, and closed lips. The sculpture is shown wearing draped garments that cross over the chest, gathered at the shoulders and falling in deep folds. The material of the bust is rendered in shades of brown and beige, with visible cracks and breaks suggesting age and damage. There are remnants of faded red and blue pigments visible on various parts of the bust, indicating traces of original paint. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, highlighting the form and color of the bust without distraction.
title: Figurehead
